# Guidance for Amina's parents

**Learner:** Amina, Grade 6, Hillview Primary, class 6B Mathematics

## Headline

Amina is doing well. Two things to work on this week: adding fractions and adding decimals.

## Focus item 1: Make the bottoms match before adding fractions

**What to do:** Make the bottoms the same, then add the tops.

**Why:** Amina adds the tops and the bottoms instead of making the bottoms the same. When the bottoms match, she can add the tops. Her teacher says she explains her thinking clearly, so she can say each step out loud as she works. This fixes all three missed fraction questions.

**Evidence:** Class Test 1, questions 1, 2 and 4 - result ids a8d3d4a6-cec1-4c65-9c34-c2f69fad6fb1, 1819db53-a011-4943-b823-cfa618af9043, e8677e8b-3f11-469b-a49d-95843b52b230 (from her open gap in adding fractions with different denominators).

## Focus item 2: Line up the comma in decimals

**What to do:** Line up the comma, not the last digits, so each digit is lined up with what it is worth.

**Why:** Amina lines up the last digits instead of the comma. Lining up what each digit is worth fixes the three missed decimal questions.

**Evidence:** Class Test 1, question 8 - result id c9d262fe-7b98-4c26-b1a6-17d8a3cb6402; Homework, Sunday - result ids 6825e2ce-cebf-4727-9215-80bf194ae645, d2f8dbbc-0c0d-43e9-93e3-248d23f3740a (from her open gap in adding decimals).

## Teacher's note

Her newest note, from Ms Banda on 5 November 2026, says Amina works well in a group and explains her thinking clearly. This is a strength she can use when practising these steps.

## Activities

Amina plays netball on Tuesdays and Thursdays and sings in the school choir on Fridays. A short ten-minute practice on Monday or Wednesday fits her week.

## Looking ahead

Next she can add mixed numbers. She can practise for ten minutes on Monday or Wednesday, when she does not have netball or choir.
